title: Smart Data Models - ERA RINF - Document
description: ERA Document (era:Document's own definition, verbatim, in the source ontology): Document in any of the ERA systems, e.g. reference document in RINF.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Document'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

documentUrl.description: Property. URL that is used to download a document, e.g. url for a reference document in RINF.
